summary: The PR addresses the issue of an empty __all__ attribute being ignored, but it introduces a new condition that may not be necessary.

issues.description: The change introduces a new condition to check if self.__all__ is None, which might not be necessary since the original code already handles the case where self.__all__ is an empty list.
There are no additional tests provided to verify the behavior when self.__all__ is explicitly set to None, which could lead to unexpected behavior if such a scenario arises.
